models.tooLarge: This model is too large to show here ({size}); the viewer opens files up to 512 MB.
models.tooLargeUnpacked: This model is too large to show here (unpacked over {size}); the viewer opens files up to 512 MB.

manifest.name: 3D models
manifest.description: Shows STL, 3MF, OBJ, glTF and PLY models with their textures, to turn and zoom, and reads their triangles and size for search and filters.

model_triangles.label: Triangles
model_triangles.description: The faces of the model, counted as triangles

model_width.label: Width (mm)
model_width.description: The model's width in millimetres; a file without a unit is taken as millimetres

model_depth.label: Depth (mm)
model_depth.description: The model's depth in millimetres; a file without a unit is taken as millimetres

model_height.label: Height (mm)
model_height.description: The model's height in millimetres, along the axis the file stands on; a file without a unit is taken as millimetres

model_unit.label: Model unit
model_unit.description: The unit the file declares; 3MF and glTF files declare one

model_objects.label: Objects
model_objects.description: The separate objects or meshes the file holds
